source.name: NSE FII/FPI and DII trading activity

metadata.label: Domestic capital buffer against global shocks
metadata.methodology: Each run archives NSE's current provisional daily observation. Monthly sums, rolling 12-month flows and the DII offset ratio are calculated only from the accumulated official archive.
metadata.note: Partial accumulating bundle: NSE's public endpoint exposes today's provisional activity, not a historical daily download. Twelve-month measures remain null until twelve consecutive archived months exist. Institutional buying may reduce disruption without improving fundamentals and does not equal retail participation.

dii_net_flow.label: DII net equity flow
dii_net_flow.methodology: sum daily net values by calendar month
dii_net_flow.source_note: Exchange activity definitions and coverage must remain stable.

fpi_net_flow.label: FII/FPI net equity flow
fpi_net_flow.methodology: sum daily net values by calendar month
fpi_net_flow.source_note: NSE activity is not identical to NSDL custodial flow data.

dii_rolling_12m.label: DII rolling 12-month flow
dii_rolling_12m.source_note: Early observations lack a full window.

fpi_rolling_12m.label: FPI rolling 12-month flow
fpi_rolling_12m.source_note: Early observations lack a full window.

dii_offset_ratio.label: DII offset ratio
dii_offset_ratio.source_note: Ratios above one do not imply that DII caused market stability.
